```yaml
name: Draft Release

on:
  workflow_dispatch:
    inputs:
      new_version:
        description: 'New version number (optional)'
        required: false
        type: string
      model:
        description: 'Model abbreviation (codex, glm, kimi) (optional)'
        required: false
        type: string

jobs:
  draft-release:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Checkout repository
        uses: actions/checkout@v2

      - name: Set up Node.js
        uses: actions/setup-node@v2
        with:
          node-version: '14'

      - name: Install dependencies
        run: npm install

      - name: Resolve model abbreviation
        id: select_model
        uses: ./.github/actions/select-opencode-model
        with:
          input-text: ${{ github.event.inputs.model }}
        env:
          GITHUB_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}

      - name: Determine version
        if: github.event.inputs.new_version == ''
        run: echo "VERSION=$(node -p \"require('./package.json').version\")" >> $GITHUB_ENV

      - name: Create release branch and PR
        run: |
          git checkout -b release/v$VERSION
          git add .
          git commit -m "Release v$VERSION"
          git push origin release/v$VERSION
          gh pr create --base main --head release/v$VERSION --title "Release v$VERSION" --body "This is a draft release."
          gh release create v$VERSION --prerelease --draft

      - name: Set outputs
        run: |
          echo "release_branch=release/v$VERSION" >> $GITHUB_ENV
          echo "release_pr_url=https://github.com/$GITHUB_REPOSITORY/pulls?q=is%3Apr+is%3Aopen+head%3Arelease%2Fv$VERSION" >> $GITHUB_ENV
```

```yaml
name: Publish Assets

on:
  pull_request:
    branches:
      - main

jobs:
  build-and-upload:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    needs: draft-release
    steps:
      - name: Checkout repository
        uses: actions/checkout@v2

      - name: Set up Node.js
        uses: actions/setup-node@v2
        with:
          node-version: '14'

      - name: Install dependencies
        run: npm install

      - name: Build binaries
        run: npm run build

      - name: Upload binaries to draft release
        run: |
          PR_URL=${{ needs.draft-release.outputs.release_pr_url }}
          RELEASE_BRANCH=${{ needs.draft-release.outputs.release_branch }}
          curl -X POST -H "Authorization: token ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}" \
            https://api.github.com/repos/${{ github.repository }}/releases/tags/v${{ github.ref_name }} \
            -d "{\"draft\":true,\"tag_name\":\"v${{ github.ref_name }}\",\"target_commitish\":\"$RELEASE_BRANCH\",\"name\":\"v${{ github.ref_name }}\",\"body\":\"Release assets for v${{ github.ref_name }}\",\"assets\":[{\"name\":\"binary.zip\",\"label\":\"Binary Archive\"}]}"

      - name: Close draft PR
        run: |
          PR_URL=${{ needs.draft-release.outputs.release_pr_url }}
          curl -X PATCH -H "Authorization: token ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}" \
            $PR_URL \
            -d "{\"state\":\"closed\"}"
```

```yaml
    types: [completed]

  publish:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Checkout repository
        uses: actions/checkout@v2

      - name: Set up Node.js
        uses: actions/setup-node@v2
        with:
          node-version: '14'

      - name: Install dependencies
        run: npm install

      - name: Publish to npm
        run: npm publish
        env:
          NODE_AUTH_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.NPM_TOKEN }}
```
